units.source_text: 我的财产仅有一只装身边杂物的柳条箱和一只破旧的小皮箱而且。

en.t: My only possessions were a wicker trunk for the odds and ends I kept with me and one shabby little leather suitcase.

units.source_text: 我早就想把它们全部烧光。

en.t: I had long wanted to burn them all to ashes.

units.source_text: 今晚我已经将书籍、衣物、僧衣以及零星杂物统统装进了这两只箱子里。

en.t: Tonight I had already packed my books, clothes, monk's robes, and assorted odds and ends into those two boxes.

units.source_text: 请相信我办事的周密性。

en.t: Please believe how carefully I had arranged everything.

units.source_text: 但凡搬运途中容易发出响声的东西，譬如蚊帐钧一类东西，

en.t: Anything likely to make noise while being carried, such as mosquito net hooks and the like,

units.source_text: 烧不着会留下证据的东西，譬如烟灰碟、玻璃杯、墨水瓶一类的东西，

en.t: and anything that might fail to burn and leave evidence behind, such as ashtrays, glasses, and ink bottles,

units.source_text: 我就用坐垫包裹，然后用包袱皮包起来，分类放开。

en.t: I wrapped in cushions, then bundled in wrapping cloths, and set aside by type.

units.source_text: 还有一床褥子和两床棉被，必须烧掉。

en.t: There was also one mattress and two cotton quilts, which had to be burned.

units.source_text: 我把这些大件行李分散地搬到大书院后面的出口处。

en.t: I carried these large pieces of baggage separately to the exit behind the great study hall.

units.source_text: 搬运完毕，我才去拆卸金阁北侧的板门。

en.t: Only after I had finished carrying everything did I go to remove the wooden door on the north side of the Golden Pavilion.
